info.title: API.SH: ALDI Australia
info.description: The ALDI Australia API from API.SH: public ALDI Australia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The full category tree (departments, aisles and promotions such as New Low Price) with ids, paths and product counts, plus all brands and themes with counts, and the total number of products in the range.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-au-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every product in one category (the site's category pages, e.g. /products/bakery/k/920000000), with the category's name, its subcategories and brand facets; same product fields as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Prices are ALDI Australia's national shelf prices in AUD (aldi.com.au has no store or postcode choice). ALDI does not publish barcodes (GTIN/EAN); `sku` is ALDI's own article number.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-au-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id or an aldi.com.au /products/.../k/<id> link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), name_asc, name_desc, price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only this brand (names as in facets.brands, e.g. FARMDALE).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Chocolate Chip Brioche Milk Rolls 8 Pack 280g

get.description:
One product: name, brand, size, price, unit price, was price and savings, description, ingredients, allergens, nutritional claims, warnings, storage and usage instructions, country of origin, categories and every image in full size. Prices are ALDI Australia's national shelf prices in AUD (aldi.com.au has no store or postcode choice). ALDI does not publish barcodes (GTIN/EAN); `sku` is ALDI's own article number.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-au-product

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: ALDI's article number (e.g. 000000000000200998) or the product's aldi.com.au link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Chocolate Chip Brioche Milk Rolls 8 Pack 280g
example.description: An easy-to-share pack of 8 mini brioche rolls with chocolate chips. Yum.
example.storage: Shelf Stable (stable after opening): Store in a cool, dry place.

get.description:
Search ALDI Australia's range by keyword, optionally inside a category, brand or theme, with the site's sorts. Each product has sku, name, brand, size, price, unit price (e.g. "$1.89 per 100 g"), was price and savings when shown, categories, link and images, plus facets (categories, brands, themes) for the result. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Prices are ALDI Australia's national shelf prices in AUD (aldi.com.au has no store or postcode choice). ALDI does not publish barcodes (GTIN/EAN); `sku` is ALDI's own article number.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/aldi-au-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords (or leave empty and give a category, brand or theme).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only this category: an id from /aldi-au/v1/categories or an aldi.com.au /products/.../k/<id> link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), name_asc, name_desc, price_asc or price_desc.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only this brand (names as in facets.brands, e.g. FARMDALE).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
